description: Tests for idempotency when re-ingesting datasets across server restarts or pipeline executions. Robustness category R.

fixtures.input_condition: Ingesting the same baseline or test record set twice in separate pipeline runs

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Subject Alpha observed at Test Location A with phone +91-9876543210.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Re-ingestion must yield identical node and edge counts if cache is intact; without persistent deduplication storage, re-running can cause state drifts.
fixtures.rationale: Pipeline uses in-memory deduplication during collection. Cache invalidation followed by re-run resets and rebuilds cleanly.
fixtures.weakness_description: Ingestion idempotency is maintained at the runtime cache layer. If force_reload=True is triggered concurrently or storage is bypassed, persistent entity deduplication is not guaranteed.
